vb_textbox.text: There are 2 groups of gnomes. Group 1: Blue, orange, red, purple; Group 2: Green, yellow, brown, pink. There will be one gnome from each group each time. You'll notice that each group will produce higher yields at one time. Then they'll swap over. If you have 2 small yields, try swapping to choosing the other group. Sometimes, it can feel like complete chance because they swap quite quickly, but most of the time you'll have about 10 tries with each group before the higher yield will swap to the other group. Use your instincts and just keep trying.
